title: Slice and wrap a portion of cooked ham
instruction: Slice one portion of prosciutto with the guarded slicer, place it in the food envelope, and fold the envelope closed.
context: A deli order couples a controlled slicer pass with collecting and wrapping a thin, easily damaged portion.
setup: Two YAM arms start open in their ready pose, with bases 610 mm apart and the tabletop at z = 747.5 mm. Coordinates in mm use the midpoint between bases as the planar origin, with x forward and y left. The fixed slicer has a 440 × 224 mm metal-style base centered at (410, −55), a 200 mm rotary disc centered at (451, 42), a rear and upper guard, and red stop and white start buttons at (179, −235) and (213, −235). Its metal-style carriage is 184 × 134 mm, starts at (290, −20), and travels 73.5 mm in +x. The carriage carries one rounded cooked ham, roughly 64 × 139 × 64 mm, with a 3.4 mm slice modeled at the cut face. A fixed metal-style catcher with a 102 × 60 mm floor sits at (416, 83), with two lips that leave the slice edge exposed. A fixed 142 × 136 mm rigid paper-envelope proxy sits at (210, 180), with its 124 mm flap upright. The slicer is initially stopped. The buttons are 22 mm in diameter with up to 8 mm of spring-return travel.
scoring: Score 1.0 after one continuous second with the slicer stopped after a cut, the entire released slice inside the envelope, and the flap at most 10 degrees from flat. The slice must stay at least 5 mm from the conservative arm bounds and move at most 10 mm/s and 0.20 rad/s. The flap may turn at most 0.20 rad/s. Any arm or fingertip entering the 2 mm clearance around the blade disk latches a score of 0, even if it later retreats. The same applies if the ham crosses the blade face or the loose slice enters the guard zone. All other outcomes score 0.
reset_notes: Use seed 0 with fixed poses. Start with the blade stopped, carriage at the start stop, the whole ham in the carriage, and an empty envelope with its flap upright.
fidelity: PhysX models the button, carriage, catcher, gripper and flap contacts. A geometric powered sweep releases a pre-modeled rigid slice with a deflector impulse. The ham is fixed to the carriage and the envelope has a rigid hinged flap. The scorer uses conservative bounds around YAM collision hulls. Blade rotation is visual. A working gauge plate, cutting force, food deformation and interlocks are omitted.
scores: Native scripted demo: 1.0 at step 1360. Dream-1 pending.
